purpose: Make a few unequal specialist tools behave like one usable instrument: hold one source object, choose a lawful projection, inspect its result, retain a bounded trace, and RETURN evidence without inventing shared semantics or authority.

axes.input: FORM / FUNCTION / FORTITUDE candidates with exact, ranged or unknown evidence

source.identity: first 12 hex characters of browser SHA-256 over exact source bytes

bench.hard_limit_law: Reject only when a candidate's observed/ranged maximum is below a hard minimum.
bench.unknown_law: Unknown or threshold-crossing evidence remains POTENTIAL and names the missing evidence.
bench.dominance_law: A candidate is dominated only when another is guaranteed no worse on every axis and strictly better on at least one; overlapping ranges and unknowns preserve alternatives.
bench.ranking_law: No weighted winner is invented. The output is survivor set, exclusions, and what to measure next.

laws: UNEQUAL TOOLS MAY SHARE A CARRIER WITHOUT SHARING SEMANTICS
stop: Do not add another Omnitools child merely because a tool exists. Add or extract only after a repeated real task cannot be expressed by SOURCE -> existing AXIS -> TRACE -> RETURN.
